claimBoundary: This decision rejects only the coarse NY-HSG portfolio locator. It makes no approval or rejection claim for any exact New York descendant, course-specific expectation, Plus standard, modeling standard, or Mathematical Practice.
officialSourceBoundary: High School – Introduction > Organization of the High School Standards for Mathematical Content
evidenceGaps: NY-HSG supplies no exact assessable action, conditions, representations, or limits.
Full-intent comparison requires an exact New York descendant expectation and its complete course-specific wording.
The lesson evidence cannot establish alignment to an entire conceptual category.
Challenge and transfer tags were not used to infer transfer or mastery.
